user_input: 查找172.20.23.95 Oracle数据库的当前会话数及长空闲会话

expected_output.description: skill 应输出当前会话数、会话使用率、长空闲会话数，并按会话使用率阈值给出判断
expected_output.judgment_rule: 会话使用率<60%→正常；>=60%→提示用户

assertions.name: 会话数正确性
assertions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS current_sessions FROM v$session
assertions.logic: skill 报告的 current_sessions 与真实 v$session 计数一致

assertions.name: 使用率计算正确性
assertions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*)/(SELECT value FROM v$parameter WHERE name='sessions')*100,2) AS usage_pct FROM v$session
assertions.logic: skill 报告的 sessions_usage_pct 与真实计算一致

assertions.name: 阈值判断正确性
assertions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*)/(SELECT value FROM v$parameter WHERE name='sessions')*100,2) AS usage_pct FROM v$session
assertions.logic: skill 的 judgment 必须等于 judgment_rule 应用于实际 usage_pct 的结果

assertions.name: 长空闲会话正确性
assertions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS idle_count FROM v$session WHERE status='INACTIVE' AND username IS NOT NULL AND last_call_et > 1800
assertions.logic: skill 报告的长空闲会话数与真实一致
